svg.title: Sarvajna-Amogh runtime path
svg.desc: Vertical flow from load generation through the vulnerable application, kernel observation, collection, durable transport, correlation and automated response, with a labelled feedback loop from the revocation store back into the application.
svg.text: trace identifier carried into the process environment
telemetry and control flow
Load generation
Locust, 10 users, 30 s per cell, about 170 requests per second
benign and attack tasks weighted 13 to 6
ground-truth row written after each response returns
Vulnerable application
trace identifier minted per request in async-local storage
written into the environment of every spawned process
ping to execve, reports to file open, preview to connect
a revoked principal is refused with 403
Kernel observation
Tetragon, eBPF, DaemonSet in kube-system
kprobes on file open and connect, scoped by pod selector
process exec from the base sensor, which has no pod scope
revocation
in force
Collection and normalisation
Vector, two file tails: application log and kernel export
stamps source, event type, pod and three timestamps
Durable transport
NATS JetStream, pull consumers, explicit acknowledgement
Correlation engine
one replica, because the indexes cannot be shared
keyed by trace identifier, object path, address and port
only denial records enter the resource indexes
every accepted event receives exactly one named outcome
Automated response
tier 1 revokes the attributed principal
tier 2 labels the pod for network isolation
Revocation store
polled every 500 ms
Network policy
isolates the labelled pod
